# one_trait_ring_create_sized_effect = { TYPE = <maa type> }: character scope, scope:ring_n = the whole companies
# wanted. Creates ONE regiment of exactly that size (a literal per branch, create_maa_regiment takes no script
# value). 1 to 500 are exact: 500 companies is the most any grant or conversion needs (Count 50,000 at the Godlike
# stack of 500 is 100; at the Regular stack of 100 it is 500). The final else (ring_n above 500, only an unusual
# conversion) creates a regiment of 500.
